Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG character sheet, exactly SIX UNIQUE KFB SLOPS, absurd-surreal cartoon claymation ink blob PIRATES / PRIVATEERS / SEA ROVERS, including a DIESELPUNK SPACE PIRATE COUPLE. Strict 3 columns by 2 rows, full independent silhouettes with clear transparent gutters, whole props and generous safe margin inside EVERY cell. No touching adjacent cells. Two space pirate partners occupy bottom middle and bottom right, one character per cell: six characters TOTAL, NOT seven or eight.
Actual supplied ORIGINALS are STYLE references, NOT edit targets: first for softly rounded thick dark ink splat morphology, tactile modeled lips/lids and irregular teeth; second for rich handcrafted occupational costume/prop design in modeled clay. Do not copy identical angry grins or glowing red eyes. Entire continuous FOOTLESS black/deep purple ink blob bodies with thick irregular drooping or curling lobes, few detached goo droplets. Visible handmade plasticine, soft sculpted volumes, subtle fingerprints, restrained purple sheen, soft warm studio light. ALL eyes WHITE/ivory sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, distinct lids. Unique silhouette, gaze, mouth, posture and temperament before costume; no six hat swaps, no standard cute animated-film face. Rich boldly shaped clay brass, wood, velvet, worn iron, rope, leather. One or two strong prop anchors per person. Visceral charming weirdness, simple immediate bodily acting, no complicated visual riddles. Partial clothes never hide the complete ink base. Female-read through subtle lashes, quiff or scarf, no human anatomy.
TOP LEFT: squat broad barrel-shaped veteran pirate captain, huge battered black tricorn with thick sculpted ivory skull ornament, ragged burgundy shoulder cape. One eye covered by plain leather patch, other WHITE sclera red iris black pupil half-lidded suspiciously; mouth clenched lopsided underbite with THREE uneven gold/ivory teeth. Thick goo hand grips a short curved cutlass with chunky shell-shaped brass guard, another cradles battered rum jug with cork; swaggering snarling old sea dog, not laughing.
TOP CENTER: FEMALE-READ lithe tall privateer duelist, long curling goo crest and faded coral headscarf, small pearl earring, short sea-green brocade collar. Mischievous sidelong wide-eyed toothy grin, one lid cocked. Holds a beautifully exaggerated brass-and-dark-wood flintlock pistol muzzle pointed upward away from people, other goo arm curls around a compact leather purse overflowing with three BIG gold coins. Elastic angled lean, complete ink body.
TOP RIGHT: compact pear-shaped secretive treasure raider, ragged indigo hood, thick brass hoop, big round WHITE eyes/red irises/black pupils gazing down greedily, pursed O-mouth and one fang. Both goo hands clutch an open small treasure chest, just a few HUGE shiny sculpted gold coins and a ruby reflecting in his eyes. His goo curls protectively around the treasure, no clutter or floating symbols.
BOTTOM LEFT: very low broad puddle buccaneer cook, droopy red bandana, one tiny gold earring, one eye squints shut and other bulges, enormous raucous toothy laugh with thick pink tongue; hefts a large chunky wooden tankard with cream foam in one goo hand, other hand holds a thick cooked fish on a short skewer. One curved goo lobe like an absurd proud moustache, still ink not hair. Rounded tactile props, debauched cartoony old seadog.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: SPACE PIRATE COUPLE partner A, FEMALE-READ dieselpunk rocket corsair captain. Tall asymmetric ink splat, weathered teal leather aviator cap, brass goggles pushed up, cropped crimson naval shoulder cape, TWO chunky riveted brass rocket cylinders on back with short orange clay flame puffs. Confident knowing CLOSED smile with one gold fang, WHITE eyes red iris black pupil gazing RIGHT toward partner B. Holds a stubby art-deco brass ray pistol with broad round dish muzzle pointing down. A small copper heart-shaped clasp on cape pairs with partner's matching clasp. Elegant tough cartoon swagger, no human legs/torso.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SPACE PIRATE COUPLE partner B, stocky round dieselpunk salvage buccaneer, rust-red patched aviator hood, half-open old-fashioned round brass helmet collar framing goo head, not enclosing or hiding face. Same teal/crimson/brass palette and matching small copper heart clasp. Huge delighted goofy uneven-tooth grin, one eye larger, WHITE sclera/red iris/black pupils gazing LEFT toward partner A affectionately. Cradles one chunky salvaged rocket engine with a flared exhaust bell and three short rounded cooling fins, worn clay metal. Small antenna on cap curved into a soft loop, very clearly a complete dark ink blob, no robot/humanoid suit. Partners connected by palette, heart clasps and reciprocal gaze, but silhouettes NOT touching.
No typography, labels, letters, floating punctuation, floor, scene, shadow disc, gradients or opaque backdrop. True transparent alpha background including all gaps/holes; ignore reference backgrounds. EXACTLY SIX full unique pirate ink monsters in 3x2.
